create_HistPlot: create a HistPlot instance to draw histograms with configurable bins, bottom offset, weights, and range on matplotlib axes
create_KdePlot: create a KdePlot instance to draw kernel density estimation plots with configurable bandwidth method and evaluation points
build_grouped_hist: build a grouped histogram that splits data by a categorical column and renders separate subplot histograms per group
run_hist_series: run histogram plotting on a pandas Series with optional by grouping, configurable bins, legend, and tick rotation
run_hist_frame: run histogram plotting on a pandas DataFrame with optional column selection, grouping by a column, and subplot layout
